title: S0 intake record
description: S0 has no agent (pure SCRIPT, scripts/intake_check.py) and its human-facing output, register/intake_report.md, is markdown, not JSON — Section 8/S0 names no JSON output shape. This schema is this build's own design for the structured record intake_check.py should assemble per required item (one of: an NCERT book/lab-manual cell of the subject x class x edition grid, a year x sitting paper+key pair, or a legacy sheet) before it is rendered into intake_report.md and before S0_MISSING_INPUT flags are written. Field names follow inputs/manifest.csv's columns (Section 8/S0 Reads) plus the status this step computes.

item_type.description: Which required-input check (procedure step 2, 3 or 5) produced this record.

edition.description: Set for item_type ncert_book / lab_manual; from the manifest row's edition column.

year.description: Set for item_type paper / key. 2016-2026 per procedure step 3; 2013-2015 are tracked too but marked in_scope=no (step 4).

booklet_code.description: Set for item_type paper / key, when the sitting's papers are coded.

file.description: Path under inputs/ to the file this record resolved to, or null when missing.

in_scope.description: false for papers/keys outside 2016-2026 pending the owner's 2013-2015 decision (Section 2.7, Section 20); null when not applicable (e.g. ncert_book, legacy_sheet).

status.description: present: exactly one manifest row and one file found. missing: required combination has no file -> S0_MISSING_INPUT (blocker). out_of_scope: found but excluded from Stage B onward by procedure step 4.

note.description: e.g. 'provisional key, not final' or 'covers all booklet codes'. May be empty.
